def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Pack largest models first, then repeatedly apply the best KVPR-lowering move or swap."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    for model in sorted(
        models, key=lambda m: (m.model_size, m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True
    ):
        size = model.model_size
        pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
        best = min(
            (i for i in range(gpu_num) if size <= free[i]),
            key=lambda i: load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf"),
            default=None,
        )
        if best is None:
            raise ValueError("Models do not fit in available GPU memory")
        placement[best].append(model)
        free[best] -= size
        load[best] += pressure

    for _ in range(len(models)):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best_score = max(ratios)
        best_move = None

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for model in placement[src]:
                size = model.model_size
                pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if src == dst or size > free[dst]:
                        continue
                    src_ratio = (load[src] - pressure) / (free[src] + size)
                    dst_free = free[dst] - size
                    dst_ratio = (load[dst] + pressure) / dst_free if dst_free else float("inf")
                    score = max(
                        src_ratio if i == src else dst_ratio if i == dst else ratios[i]
                        for i in range(gpu_num)
                    )
                    if score < best_score:
                        best_score = score
                        best_move = (src, dst, model, size, pressure)

        # Compare every feasible swap with relocations in the same round.
        # A swap can reduce the maximum KVPR more than the best single move.
        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for dst in range(src + 1, gpu_num):
                for left in placement[src]:
                    for right in placement[dst]:
                        left_size, right_size = left.model_size, right.model_size
                        left_load = left.req_rate / left.slo
                        right_load = right.req_rate / right.slo
                        src_free = free[src] + left_size - right_size
                        dst_free = free[dst] + right_size - left_size
                        if src_free <= 0 or dst_free <= 0:
                            continue
                        score = max(
                            (load[src] - left_load + right_load) / src_free if i == src else
                            (load[dst] - right_load + left_load) / dst_free if i == dst else
                            ratios[i]
                            for i in range(gpu_num)
                        )
                        if score < best_score:
                            best_score = score
                            best_move = ("swap", src, dst, left, right,
                                         left_size, right_size, left_load, right_load)

        if best_move is None:
            break
        if best_move[0] == "swap":
            _, src, dst, left, right, left_size, right_size, left_load, right_load = best_move
            placement[src].remove(left)
            placement[dst].remove(right)
            placement[src].append(right)
            placement[dst].append(left)
            free[src] += left_size - right_size
            free[dst] += right_size - left_size
            load[src] += right_load - left_load
            load[dst] += left_load - right_load
        else:
            src, dst, model, size, pressure = best_move
            placement[src].remove(model)
            placement[dst].append(model)
            free[src] += size
            free[dst] -= size
            load[src] -= pressure
            load[dst] += pressure

    return placement

            _, src, dst, left, right, left_size, right_size, left_load, right_load = best_move
            placement[src].remove(left)
            placement[dst].remove(right)
            placement[src].append(right)
            placement[dst].append(left)
            free[src] += left_size - right_size
            free[dst] += right_size - left_size
            load[src] += right_load - left_load
            load[dst] += left_load - right_load
        else:
            src, dst, model, size, pressure = best_move
            placement[src].remove(model)
            placement[dst].append(model)
            free[src] += size
            free[dst] -= size
            load[src] -= pressure
            load[dst] += pressure

    return placement
